method: Original STL horizontal triangle-plane intersections every 0.2 mm; endpoints clustered within 0.0001mm numerical tolerance; graph degrees must all equal 2; every contour polygon must be valid. Closed loop regions use even-odd nesting.

thin_screen.interpretation: Screening flags narrow XY protrusions, isolated small contour islands and tapering roof tips. Not a full 3D wall-thickness proof, not automatic unprintability.

limitations: Geometric sections only: no nozzle paths, extrusion width, support generation, bridge quality or G-code was validated.
Sample planes do not cover every possible Z and do not prove minimum wall thickness.
Compare flagged layers and source dimensions in the printing notes before production.
